answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with walks of at most \(k\) steps, preventing unbounded diffusion. A Sybil cluster \(S\) behind a sparse external cut has low conductance, \(\phi(S)=w(\partial S)/\mathrm{vol}(S)\), so few walk transitions enter it. When votes are weighted by propagated trust, this bounds the cluster’s aggregate voting weight by trust leakage across the cut, not by its internally multiplied identities—like a river plume entering a hollow, its spread is limited at the boundary.
